## Summary

Describe the change and user-visible impact. Link any related issue.

## Verification

- [ ] Ruff lint/format, mypy and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] No credentials, device identifiers, vendor artifacts or private exports included.
- [ ] Existing entity identities and saved options remain compatible.
- [ ] Docs/changelog updated when behaviour or installation changes.

For device behaviour changes, distinguish simulated tests, ACK/readback evidence
and attended physical output. State hardware limitations explicitly. Documentation
or repository-only changes do not require a hardware trial.
